decisive_items: heterogeneous, focally hyperdense lesion of the left middle turbinate
response.rationale: Chronic unilateral sinonasal symptoms with CT hyperdense material and no bony erosion favor non-invasive allergic fungal sinusitis over invasive fungal sinusitis, which would more likely show bone erosion and a more aggressive course.

rejected.why: Antibiotic-refractory course, hyperdense CT lesion, and suspected fungal etiology make chronic bacterial sinusitis unlikely.
Granulomatous mucosa and facial pain are nonspecific; absence of systemic/renal/pulmonary features and presence of a hyperdense fungal-type lesion make GPA unlikely.
Diabetes is a risk factor, but the 3-month indolent course and explicit absence of bony erosion argue against invasive fungal sinusitis.
